description: Custom ECL queries for the glomerular filtration rate (eGFR). The LOINC Ontology models GFR observables without a Component: they carry Process output = 580101010000109 |Glomerular filtration rate (calculation)|. The pool therefore uses an explicit component_ecl on that attribute.
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: GFR, any specimen
queries.description: All observables whose process output is the GFR calculation.
